style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Stumbling Blocks and Mustard Seed Faith
images.concept: Impossible faith made possible — the servant who does what is required without demanding reward
images.imageAlt: A single small seed resting in a crack between large cobblestones, the stones massive and weathered, the seed almost invisible
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close overhead view of ancient cobblestones with a single tiny seed resting in the crack between two massive stones, the seed almost invisible against the dark crack, raking side light revealing the texture of the weathered stone surfaces and the depth of the crack, the seed the only living thing in a landscape of heavy stone, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of pale stone and dark shadow, Alabaster Books extreme attention to small scale, 16:9 with the crack running diagonally and the seed at the intersection of stone and shadow, faith's smallness against the mass of what it is asked to move

images.title: Ten Healed, One Returns
images.concept: Nine walking away and one turning back — the rarer gift of gratitude
images.imageAlt: Nine sets of footprints continuing away in one direction, one single set of footprints turning sharply back toward the viewer
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead view of soft pale dust or dry earth, nine sets of footprints all continuing forward in the same direction toward the upper frame, and one single set of footprints turning sharply and returning toward the lower frame, all tracks in the same soil, the same depth, but one trajectory radically different, warm even light, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm earth palette, Kinfolk spare aerial geometry, 16:9 with the diverging track visible and unmistakable, the choice to return held in the single turned path

images.title: The Kingdom Does Not Come with Signs
images.concept: Lightning that lights the whole sky — the coming that will be unmistakable and sudden
images.imageAlt: A dark storm sky at dusk with a single bolt of lightning frozen mid-flash, illuminating the entire underside of the clouds
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a dark storm sky at dusk, a single bolt of lightning captured frozen mid-flash across the entire width of the frame, the underside of the storm clouds illuminated from within by the flash, the earth below barely visible as a dark thin strip, the light total and instantaneous, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the dark cloud zones, muted near-monochrome palette of deep gray-blue and white-silver lightning, Alabaster Books scale and awe, 16:9 with the lightning stretching across the full width and the illuminated clouds filling the upper three-quarters, the inescapable visibility of what is coming
